subject.title: Feature: configPatch in plugin manifest — automatic config setup on install

question: Which typed configuration operations and shared paths may third-party plugin setup request, and what confirmation, conflict, and recovery guarantees are mandatory?
rationale: This creates a public third-party authority boundary over persisted operator configuration; code inspection cannot choose the permanent trust and consent policy.

options.title: Typed consented operations
options.body: Allow validated path-scoped operations with preview, explicit confirmation, path policy, conflict semantics, and provenance.

options.title: Plugin namespace only
options.body: Restrict automatic setup to plugin-owned configuration and require owner-specific setup flows for shared settings.

options.title: Manual shared setup
options.body: Keep shared configuration manual and improve post-install setup guidance or wizard launch behavior.

recommendation.title: Typed consented operations
recommendation.body: Allow validated path-scoped operations with preview, explicit confirmation, path policy, conflict semantics, and provenance.

likelyOwner.reason: This person combines the strongest recent code-history signal with direct review of the exact product and security decision.
